g.text: POST challenge / GET response / DELETE session
Shared verification code and Solana state
Solid arrows: runtime interaction. Dotted arrows: code/configuration dependency.
Daemon components group functions; they are not separate services.
Failures deny login. In-memory sessions belong to one PAM socket connection.
Local test-services: gateway :8080, fixture RPC :8899, loopback HTTP only.
Local CLI signing replaces the browser; no deployed program or SOL transfer.
Login only reads on-chain state. Grant changes affect new logins.
